title: Xproguard Firewall
full_description: Xproguard Firewall allows you to block apps from accessing the internet without root requirement.Blocking access to the internet can help:* Reduce your data usage* Save your battery* Increase your privacy* Take Control Of Your Mobile Apps* Easily Allow/Block App Connectivity* Block background app activityWith the firewall App, reduce your data usage, save your battery, protect your privacy, take back the better Android life you deserve.Show information about installed applications:- package name- version name and code- installer package- minimal and target sdk- installation and last update timeThis is the perfect firewall solution for android without root. It gives you a complete network protection for your device. This app is based on VPN interface, which is the only way to implement the firewall on no-root devices.This app uses the Android VPNService to route traffic to itself so that it can be filtered on-device instead of on a server.Contact usIf you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach us on contact@xproguard.com or visit our website https://www.xproguard.com for more information.
